system_deps: MuJoCo 2.1 binaries and a C compiler for mujoco-py
install.notes: The pinned upstream depends on mujoco-worldgen and was tested only on Mac OS X and Ubuntu 16.04 with Python 3.6 (README.md:7-14); the installed package also needs MuJoCo 2.1 and a C compiler for mujoco-py. The gate and the fake backend need none of that: fake.py is pure Python. Install the upstream only to serve its own simulator, which was not run here and for which this repository has no registered Gym id.
